viewports.title: HowRipe — How to Pick Ripe Fruit
viewports.description: Learn how to pick ripe fruit, tell when it is ready to eat, and plan ripening and storage. Explore practical avocado, kiwi, pomegranate and persimmon guides.
viewports.meaningfulText: A FIELD GUIDE TO RIPE FRUIT Pick better fruit. Know what’s ripe, when to eat it, and how to keep it at its best. THE FRUIT INDEX Choose a fruit. A few good clues. A better choice at the market. Firmness · Timing · Damage Avocado Find the gentle give. Pick for when you’ll eat it. Explore guide Ripeness · Storage · Timing Kiwi Know when it’s ready. Keep the rest on your schedule. Explore guide Weight · Shape · Skin Pomegranate Look beyond the red. Learn what to feel and inspect. Explore guide Fuyu · Hachiya · Ready to eat Persimmon Start with the type. Firm means different things. Explore guide A LITTLE KNOW-HOW GOES A LONG WAY No universal trick. Just the right clues. Firmness, weight, skin, variety. Every fruit tells a different story. Learn what matters for the one in your hand.

headings.text: No universal trick. Just the right clues.
